analysis.headline: Shares Your Data With Affiliates
analysis.quote: Learn how Asana engages third-party subprocessors and Asana affiliates to help us provide services to our customers.

analysis.headline: AI Partners Use Your Content
analysis.quote: Asana AI features powered by AI Partners use metadata, personal information, and user-generated content (e.g., task titles and task descriptions).

analysis.headline: Responds To Government Requests
analysis.quote: Asana only responds to law enforcement requests that adhere to established legal process and applicable law.

analysis.headline: Your Data Stored Globally
analysis.quote: Asana is a global company and data will be transferred to regions where our subprocessors and affiliates are located.

analysis.headline: Limits On Your Own DPA
analysis.quote: The provisions of Asana’s DPA reflect Asana’s services and multi-tenant infrastructure.

analysis.headline: Do Not Store Sensitive Data
analysis.quote: Customers should not store sensitive personal data (including financial account numbers and social security numbers) in Asana.
